welcome.text: Hello Clover. Welcome to your little world. Shall we visit our friends, or make your very own monster?

explore.text: Move with the stick, or the arrow keys. Follow the pictures to meet your friends. Press the green A button when you get close.

home.text: Welcome home! Let's make this place your own. You can move your furniture, plant a seed, and give your flowers a little water.

map.text: Where shall we go? Choose a picture to visit a friend.

pause.text: Time for a little rest. Your adventure will be right here.

creator.text: Let's make your monster. Choose any colours, change your shape, and try some lovely things to wear.

garden.text: Choose a seed, then an empty patch of soil. Give it three little drinks to help it grow.

furniture.text: Choose something you own, then choose a space to put it. You can move it again whenever you like.

bought.text: That's yours now! Thank you, little friend. Take it home and find a lovely place for it.

expensive.text: A few more stars will buy that. Our friends have lots of little jobs you can help with.

owned.text: You already have that! You can find it at home.

planted.text: A tiny seed, tucked into the soil. Now let's give it some water.

watered.text: A lovely little drink. Look how your plant is growing!

grown.text: You grew it all by yourself. What a beautiful garden!

bramble-hello.text: Hello there! I'm Bramble. Welcome to my pizza shop! Our friends have brought some lovely recipes. Will you help me count the toppings and make their pizzas?

olive-hello.text: Hello, little monster. I'm Olive. The wind has scattered the sounds from my storybook. Let's listen, and put the words together again.

marina-hello.text: Ahoy, little friend! I'm Marina. My little boats are ready to deliver fish around the island. Can you help me send them on their way?

tilly-hello.text: Hello! I'm Tilly. I love growing things. Let's put our flowers together, and make a beautiful path through the garden.

poppy-hello.text: Welcome to my little shops! I'm Poppy. Spend your stars on something cosy for your house, or a little treasure for your garden.

pip-hello.text: Oh, hello! I'm Pip. My rocket had a rather bumpy landing. Could you help me mend three broken parts? Then we can fly to the moon together!

nova-hello.text: You made it to the moon! I'm Nova. Look at all those stars. Let's discover a few things about our solar system.

pip-repaired.text: You did it! The control panel, fuel tank, and star battery are all ready. Hop aboard when you're ready. We're going to the moon!

launch.text: Ready, little explorer? Three, two, one, blast off! Next stop, the moon!

return.text: Let's head home. Our friends and your garden will be waiting for us.

part.text: Wonderful! That's another part of the rocket mended. We're one step closer to the moon.

complete.text: You did it! Two lovely stars for helping your friend. Shall we play again, or explore?

again.text: Let's have another go. Take your time. We can work it out together.

learn-sound.text: Let's learn a new sound. Listen carefully, then say it with me. Now find the letters that match.

find-sound.text: Listen to the sound. Which letters make that sound?

grown-up.text: Let's ask a grown-up to say this sound with us. Then you can find the matching letters.

add.text: How many flowers are there altogether? Choose your number, then press the green button.

pattern.text: The control panel has a pattern. Look along the coloured shapes. Which shape comes next?

battery.text: How many star batteries are there altogether? Choose your number, then press the green button.

earth.text: Our home planet is called Earth. It has blue oceans and green land. Can you find Earth?

sun.text: The Sun is a star. It gives us light and warmth. Can you find the Sun?

saturn.text: Saturn has beautiful rings made of ice and rock. Can you find the planet with rings?

moon.text: The Moon travels around Earth. It shines by reflecting sunlight. Can you find the Moon?

put-away.text: All put away. There's room for something new.

ready.text: Looking lovely! Your monster is ready for an adventure.

sound-settings.text: These are the grown-up settings. You can change the learning range, and check the letter sounds.

numbers-help.text: You can touch each object and count along. There is no hurry.

pack-check.text: That basket is just right. Thank you for helping with our picnic!

help.text: Choose an object to move it. You can put it back if you change your mind. Press the tick when you are ready.

visit-home.text: Let's visit your home and garden.

bramble-success.text: Lovely work! You helped me. Here are two stars for your collection.

bramble-retry.text: Let's try again, little friend. Take your time, and have another look.

pizza-order-woods.text: Hello! Could I have a woodland pizza, please? Here is my recipe. Work out each little puzzle to find how many toppings I would like. Thank you!

pizza-order-garden.text: Hello! Could I have a garden pizza, please? Here is my recipe. Work out each little puzzle to find how many toppings I would like. Thank you!

pizza-order-cove.text: Hello! Could I have a harbour pizza, please? Here is my recipe. Work out each little puzzle to find how many toppings I would like. Thank you!

pizza-order-rocket.text: Hello! Could I have a space pizza, please? Here is my recipe. Work out each little puzzle to find how many toppings I would like. Thank you!

topping-tomato.text: Let's count the tomatoes. Work out the recipe, then add them to the pizza, one at a time.

topping-mushroom.text: Let's count the mushrooms. Work out the recipe, then add them to the pizza, one at a time.

topping-pepper.text: Let's count the peppers. Work out the recipe, then add them to the pizza, one at a time.

topping-sweetcorn.text: Let's count the pieces of sweetcorn. Work out the recipe, then add them to the pizza, one at a time.

pizza-bake.text: All the toppings match the recipe! Into the oven it goes. What a wonderful pizza!

pizza-retry.text: Let’s count the recipe pictures. Choose how many toppings we need.

pizza-next.text: Lovely! Let’s add the next topping.

space-earth-home.text: Earth is our home. Can you find our blue and green planet?

space-sun-star.text: The Sun is a star. Which picture shows the Sun?

space-mars-red.text: Mars is called the red planet. Can you find Mars?

space-saturn-rings.text: Saturn has lovely wide rings. Can you find Saturn?

space-collect-1.text: Can you collect 1 star for our Moon station?

space-pattern-1.text: Our Moon station needs a picture code. Which picture comes next?

space-mercury-small.text: Mercury is the smallest planet. Find the little grey planet.

space-venus-hot.text: Venus is the hottest planet. Find the yellow cloudy planet.

space-jupiter-big.text: Jupiter is the biggest planet. Find the big stripy planet.

space-neptune-far.text: Neptune is the planet furthest from the Sun. Find the deep blue planet.

space-collect-2.text: Can you collect 2 Moon rocks for our Moon station?

space-pattern-2.text: Our Moon station needs a picture code. Which picture comes next?

space-uranus-roll.text: Uranus spins on its side. Can you find the pale blue planet?

space-moon-neighbour.text: The Moon travels around Earth. Can you find the grey Moon?

space-earth-oceans.text: Which planet has the oceans where whales swim?

space-earth-garden.text: Which planet has real trees and gardens for us to enjoy?

space-collect-3.text: Can you collect 3 crystals for our Moon station?

space-pattern-3.text: Our Moon station needs a picture code. Which picture comes next?

space-mercury-near.text: Mercury is closest to the Sun. Find Mercury, the little grey planet.

space-venus-clouds.text: Venus is wrapped in thick clouds. Find our yellow cloudy planet.

space-jupiter-storm.text: Jupiter has a giant storm called the Great Red Spot. Find the stripy planet with a spot.

space-mars-robots.text: Our robot rovers explore Mars. Find the red planet they drive on.

space-collect-4.text: Can you collect 4 toy rockets for our Moon station?

space-pattern-4.text: Our Moon station needs a picture code. Which picture comes next?

space-moon-craters.text: The Moon has lots of round craters. Find the grey, crater-covered Moon.

space-moon-visit.text: People have walked on the Moon. Can you find the Moon?

space-moon-reflects.text: The Moon reflects sunlight. Can you find the Moon?

space-collect-5.text: Can you collect 5 batteries for our Moon station?

space-pattern-5.text: Our Moon station needs a picture code. Which picture comes next?

space-rocket-launch.text: Which vehicle blasts off into space?

space-astronaut-job.text: An astronaut is a space explorer. Can you find the astronaut?

space-space-suit.text: Who is wearing a spacesuit to help them breathe in space?

space-telescope-look.text: A telescope helps us see faraway things in space. Find the telescope.

space-collect-6.text: Can you collect 2 Moon flowers for our Moon station?

space-pattern-6.text: Our Moon station needs a picture code. Which picture comes next?

space-satellite-orbit.text: Satellites travel around planets and send us information. Find the satellite.

space-moon-rocks.text: Astronauts brought Moon rocks home to study. Which picture shows a rock?

space-sun-warmth.text: Which star sends warmth to Earth?

space-earth-air.text: Earth has air we can breathe. Find our blue and green home.

space-collect-7.text: Can you collect 3 toy satellites for our Moon station?

space-pattern-7.text: Our Moon station needs a picture code. Which picture comes next?

space-mars-two-moons.text: Mars has two little moons. Find the red planet.

space-venus-no-moon.text: Venus has no moons. Can you find the yellow cloudy planet?

space-moon-low-gravity.text: You could jump higher on the Moon than on Earth. Find the Moon.

space-sun-centre.text: The planets travel around the Sun. Which picture belongs in the middle of our solar system?

space-collect-8.text: Can you collect 4 rocket bolts for our Moon station?

space-pattern-8.text: Our Moon station needs a picture code. Which picture comes next?

tutorial-hello.text: Hello! Let us learn the buttons together. Press the green A button to begin.

tutorial-move.text: Take your monster for a little walk. Use the control pad, or the stick.

tutorial-choose.text: Choose the apple. Move right on your control pad.

tutorial-confirm.text: Lovely! Press the green A button to choose it.

tutorial-back.text: The apple is in our basket. Press the red B button to go back.

tutorial-done.text: You did it! Green A says yes. Red B goes back. Yellow Y helps you listen again. Press A to explore.

demo-bramble-pizza.text: Watch me. One tomato, and one more tomato, makes two. Move right to choose two. Then press the green A button. Your turn!

demo-tilly-add.text: Watch me. One apple, and one more apple, makes two. Move right to choose two, then press the green A button. Your turn!

demo-marina-take.text: Watch me. Three apples. Take one away. Two are left. Move right to choose two, then press the green A button. Your turn!

demo-pip-pattern.text: Watch the pattern. Circle, triangle, circle. A triangle comes next. Choose the picture, then press the green A button. Your turn!

demo-pip-pack.text: Watch me pack two apples. One, two. Move right to choose two, then press the green A button. Your turn!

demo-pip-add.text: Watch me. One apple, and one more apple, makes two. Move right to choose two, then press the green A button. Your turn!

demo-olive-sound.text: First, listen to the sound with your grown-up. Then choose its letters, and press the green A button. Yellow Y lets you watch this again.

demo-olive-spell.text: Watch me choose the letters for a word. Choose each sound with the green A button. Blue X takes the last one back. Now try your word with your grown-up.

demo-nova-space.text: Look at the pictures. A rocket can fly into space. Choose its picture, then press the green A button. Your turn!

demo-nova-pattern.text: Watch the pattern. Circle, triangle, circle. A triangle comes next. Choose the picture, then press the green A button. Your turn!

demo-nova-pack.text: Watch me pack two apples. One, two. Move right to choose two, then press the green A button. Your turn!
